scope:
Measure dynamic conditioning prefill plus an original shape/texture sampler.

Experimental FP32 two-graph execution, retaining every checkpoint parameter,
token and original Euler/CFG operation. Exact prepared CPU trajectories and the
sealed stock CPU reference are checked before native compilation. Timing covers
two resident prefill calls plus all synchronized denoiser calls (21 shape,
18 texture). Texture retains its fixed 32-channel shape concatenation. Compilation,
warmups, raw-condition upload and artifact I/O are reported separately/excluded.
dtype: pipeline mixed precision: BF16 torso, FP32 embedding/output/norm
cpu_original_equivalence: torch.testing.assert_close passed for all 30 sparse blocks and IO
adaptation: single chunk active tokens as a dense sequence; all native sparse weights including LoRA preserved
host_work: fixed coordinates and RoPE phases; precomputed image conditions

stock_cpu_trajectory.scope: One complete original 12-step trajectory, fixed noise and synthetic conditioning; no reconstruction-quality assessment

stock_cache.note: Stock FP32 trajectory reused after strict identity/hash checks; stored CPU duration describes the original computation, not this run.

precision_preparation.note: Original stock CPU reference unchanged. Promote already loaded/quantized values, not original full-precision checkpoint values. Complex and integer buffers preserved.
